layout_notes.text: Connect IN+ and IN- to the sense resistor with a Kelvin (4-wire) connection so only the shunt impedance is seen between the inputs.
Place the 0.1 uF bypass capacitor as close as possible to the VS and GND pins.
Keep the two shunt-to-input trace lengths as close as possible to minimise impedance mismatch.
Single-channel recommended layout, pinout A: shunt next to pins 3/4, via to ground plane at GND pin 2 (Figure 9-7).

gaps: INA180A3IDBVR = INA180, gain 100 V/V, DBV SOT-23-5, pinout A (device comparison p4, orderable list p32, marking 1A9D).
Pin name IN- is printed with an en dash ('IN–') in the datasheet; stored as ASCII 'IN-' for symbol mapping.
Absolute maximum for OUT is GND - 0.3 V to VS + 0.3 V (p7): the max depends on VS and is only in the conditions text. Common-mode min is GND - 0.3 V.
VSP is specified relative to VS ((VS) - 0.02 typ, (VS) - 0.03 limit, p8); stored as negative offsets from VS. Text p19 says 'maximum specified output swing to the positive rail is 30 mV'.
Electrical characteristics are at TA = 25 C, VS = 5 V, VIN+ = 12 V unless noted (p8); they are stored in recommended_operating with their conditions since the schema has no characteristics block.
Offset at VCM near 0 V with VIN+ = 0 V is +/-150 uV max (p8);
Datasheet quirk: the design example (p25) says the offset is '125 uV (maximum)' at VCM = 0 V, VS = 5 V, then uses 150 uV; the Electrical Characteristics table (p8) gives 150 uV max.
Equation variables (V_SENSE, R_F, GEF, PD_MAX, I_MAX, VOS_TOTAL, I_SENSE, R_SENSE, GAIN_ERR_PCT, OFFSET_ERR_PCT) are operating quantities or off-pin parts; no pin endpoints mapped.
No input common-mode transient protection is needed below 26 V (p26); protection options for > 26 V are application info only (p26-p27).
Inputs withstand the full 26 V differential range with or without VS applied (p26).
